summary: First full E2E run of the School Management System. Backend: 35 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_school_api.py covering auth (httpOnly cookies, refresh, CSRF origin guard, invalid login, lockout/rate limit), RBAC, students CRUD/archive/restore/search/filter/CSV, teachers/parents/create-login, classes (409 on duplicate), attendance (save, summary, future date 422), timetable (save + teacher conflict 409), exams (marks out-of-range 422, draft/submit/publish, results, report card, student sees only published), fees (generate + re-run skip, partial payment, overpayment 409, receipt, refund, void, parent scoping, Razorpay 503 not configured), homework (create/submit/grade), library issue/return, transport capacity 409, leave apply/approve + notification, announcement notifications, all 15 reports + CSV, audit logs, settings save, dashboards for 4 roles. 32/35 pass; the 3 failures are real bugs. Frontend (Playwright): login/logout for all 4 roles (role-specific dashboards and navs), invalid login error, teacher /app/settings redirects to /app, admissions create (auto ADM no) -> search -> archive -> restore, class filter, CSV export download, attendance mark Grade 9-A + summary percentages (date input max=today), timetable conflict toast, admin record partial payment with client-side overpay validation + receipt dialog, parent online-pay 'not configured' message, student report card, teacher creates homework -> student submits -> teacher grades 9/10, teacher applies leave, reports run + CSV, audit list, settings save, leave/calendar/announcements pages, dark mode toggle, mobile sidebar sheet. All requested flows work apart from the bugs listed below.

critical.issue: SECURITY: in core.crud, archive_item/restore_item skip the scope and ownership hooks. A teacher (write_roles include teacher) can archive announcements posted by the admin or other teachers, and homework owned by other teachers. Reproduced: admin posts an announcement, teacher DELETEs it, gets 200.

Archived students still show up. crud archive only sets archived=true and leaves status='active', but these queries filter on status:'active' only. Seen in the UI: archived TEST_ students were listed and marked present in the Grade 9-A attendance sheet and summary. Section capacity and transport capacity checks count them too.

Archived homework is still listed for teachers and students. list_homework never adds archived:{$ne:true}. The teacher list shows it as 'Published' with an Archive button, so archiving from the UI looks like it does nothing.

minor.issue: Pydantic v2 treats fields with a leading underscore as private attributes. They never appear in model_dump(), so the crud 'extra' dict is always empty and this create-login-on-admission path does nothing.
Returns 200 even when the id does not exist (no matched_count check).
Does not check that the class/section exists or that the teacher is assigned to that subject/section. Any teacher can be put on any subject.

Only checks exam.class_id, not exam.sections, so a student can open an exam created for a different section of the same class. Attendance on the report card counts all-time records, not the exam's academic year/term.
Clearing a mark (marks=null, absent=false) is silently skipped, so a mark that was entered by mistake cannot be removed.
body is an untyped dict. Only session_minutes and grading are validated, so wrong types (e.g. pass_percent as a string) are stored and can break result computation.
An in-memory limit of 10 logins/min per IP. It is not shared across workers, and a school computer lab behind one NAT IP will hit 429 quickly. Consider keying on ip+email or raising the limit.
The Emergent email API returns 422 'undeliverable_recipient' for the *.demo seed addresses. This is expected, but the log only prints 'Client error 422 unknown'. Log r.text so the reason is visible.

ui_bugs.issue: The first word of the name is used: 'Good morning, Dr.' for Dr. Kavita Rao and 'Good morning, School' for School Administrator.
Shows 'Home > Report-Card > Details > Details' (one 'Details' per ID segment).
After user A logs out on a deep page, user B logging in next is sent to A's last page (e.g. /app/homework) instead of the dashboard.

integration_issues.issue: Driven by the backend bugs above: archived items stay visible in the homework list, attendance sheet and summary.

design_issues.screen: All forms (FormDialog type=date, attendance date, payment and report filters)
issues: Uses the browser's native <input type='date'> (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker, so it looks different from the rest of the UI and uses a US date format in an INR/India app.
The child selector sits tight against the global search box. The toast covers the user name on login.
The sheet close (X) button overlaps the truncated school name in the brand area.

action_items: core.crud: run the scope hook and an ownership hook (e.g. hooks['before_archive']) in archive_item/restore_item; teachers may only archive their own announcements/homework

Exclude archived students everywhere the code filters status:'active' (attendance sheet/save/summary, marks, results, submissions, capacity counts), or set status='archived' when a student is archived and restore the previous status on restore
Fix StudentIn._login_password (rename it, e.g. login_password with exclude, or read it from the raw body)
Add a 404 to crud restore; validate class/section and teacher assignment in POST /timetable; check exam.sections in report-card
Minor UI: greeting name (skip honorifics / use the full name), report-card breadcrumb labels, reset the post-login redirect on logout, replace native date inputs with the shadcn date picker
critical_code_review_comments: core.crud generic archive/restore bypasses hooks (security), see backend critical #1
The status vs archived flag duality for students causes data leaks into operational screens
Pydantic private-attr misuse (_login_password) means dead code
PUT /settings accepts an untyped dict; use a Pydantic model with optional typed fields
routes_misc.py is 467 lines and growing; split it into homework/library/transport/leave/comms modules before it passes 700

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; only bug-driven issues and minor UI nits)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin, teacher, student, parent). All valid.
seed_data_creation: Created only TEST_-prefixed records (students, teachers, parents, class, exam, fee structure, invoices/payments, homework, book, route/vehicle, leaves, announcements). All of them were hard-deleted from Mongo afterwards, together with their attendance, marks, invoices, payments, submissions, notifications and users. One seeded leave decision and the attendance marks for today's Grade 9-A seed students remain (all present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_school_api.py -n 0 (must be -n 0: xdist splits the shared STATE and runs extra logins). The login rate limit is 10/min/IP, so wait about 60s between full runs and browser sessions that log in several times. The leave test uses a random future date to avoid the overlap 409. The timetable test uses its own TEST class (sections A,B). Grade 10 timetable is completely full. Today is 2026-10-24 (Sat, working day). Email to *.demo addresses fails with undeliverable_recipient (expected). Online payments return 503 (keys not configured, expected).
rca of the issue: 1) The teacher-can-archive bug: core.crud.archive_item/restore_item never call hooks['scope'] or before_save, so the ownership checks in ann_before/hw_before only run on create/update. 2) Archived students in attendance and other screens: archive sets archived=True but student.status stays 'active', and routes_academic/exams/misc filter only on status:'active'. Repro: create a student in 9-B, DELETE /api/students/{id}, GET /api/attendance/sheet?class_id=g9&section=B: the student is still listed. 3) Archived homework: routes_misc.list_homework builds q without an archived filter. Repro: DELETE /api/homework-items/{id}, GET /api/homework as the student: the item is still returned.
